$comment: Fourteen human roles and the two adopted workload roles, as agreed in document 28, issue 7.
WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 12): deployment-recorder and approval-writer are workload roles, held only through a Workload Grant (C42), never through a group.
Proposal, not adopted yet: authorization-reporter and consistency-checker are two more workload roles. They also rest on WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 12).

rows.label: Maker
rows.duties: Builds in approved environments and records links.

rows.label: Data owner
rows.duties: Decides data use for a data area.

rows.label: Architect
rows.duties: Reviews designs and grants exceptions to standards.

rows.label: Change manager
rows.duties: Runs the change schedule; authorizes tier 3 changes and emergencies.

rows.label: Change board
rows.duties: Decides exceptions about changes, and windows that cover several applications, as a group.

rows.label: PMO
rows.duties: Scores demand and runs portfolio reviews.

rows.label: AI lead
rows.duties: Keeps the AI guidelines, is consulted on agent autonomy, decides on agents Microsoft flags.

rows.label: Security reviewer
rows.duties: Runs security reviews and agrees agent autonomy levels.

rows.label: Platform admin
rows.duties: Triages intake, confirms tiers, runs the gap check.

rows.label: Auditor
rows.duties: Reads everything, including audit entries, and changes nothing.

rows.label: Reader
rows.duties: Reads the register, decisions and the change schedule. No audit entries, no restricted columns. Never writes.

rows.label: Deployment recorder
rows.duties: Held by pipeline identities through a workload grant. Writes deployment records.

rows.label: Approval writer
rows.duties: Held by the approval runner through a workload grant. Writes the person's answer on an approval record; never decides.

rows.label: Authorization reporter
rows.duties: Held by the client-built ITSM step through a workload grant. Writes authorization facts and evidence links only.

rows.label: Consistency checker
rows.duties: Held by the scheduled consistency check through a workload grant. Reads product rows and writes only "write outside the engine" audit findings.
